holoinventorymodern.command.blacklist.ta: %s stays blacklisted through the block tag #holoinventorymodern:holo_view_blacklist
holoinventorymodern.command.whitelist.ta: %s stays whitelisted through the block tag #holoinventorymodern:holo_view_whitelist
holoinventorymodern.command.offset.cente: Holograms now sit in the middle of the block
holoinventorymodern.command.offset.top: Holograms now sit at the top of the block
holoinventorymodern.command.offset.above: Holograms now float above the block
holoinventorymodern.command.offset.custo: Holograms now float above the block, moved %s right, %s up and %s forward
Negative moves it left, positive moves it right
Negative moves it down, positive moves it up
Negative moves it towards you, positive moves it away
holoinventorymodern.command.size.hint: 1 is the default size, 3 is the largest
holoinventorymodern.configuration.title: Holo Inventory Modern
holoinventorymodern.configuration.trigge: When the hologram is shown while looking at a container.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.showNa: Draw the container name above the contents.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.showCo: Draw the stack size on each item.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.showEn: Peek into entities that carry a container, such as chest minecarts.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.size.t: Size of the hologram, where 1 is the default. /holoinventorymodern size sets it in game.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.backgr: Opacity of the panel behind the contents. 0 removes it.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.anchor: Where the hologram sits: in the middle of the block, at its top, above it, or above it and moved by the custom offset. /holoinventorymodern offset sets it in game.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.custom: Blocks to the viewer's right while the hologram position is Custom. Negative moves it left.
Blocks upwards while the hologram position is Custom. Negative moves it down.
Blocks away from the viewer while the hologram position is Custom. Negative moves it closer.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.anchor: Moves the hologram for specific blocks, such as multiblocks or blocks that look larger than one block. Each entry is <block id>=<x>,<y>,<z> in blocks, added to wherever the hologram position puts it.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.maximu: Largest number of distinct stacks reported for one container.
Largest distance in blocks at which contents are reported.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.showLo: Report containers whose loot has not been generated yet. Looking at one generates its loot for the viewer, as opening it would.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.blackl: Block ids whose contents are never reported. The block tag #holoinventorymodern:holo_view_blacklist does the same from a datapack.
holoinventorymodern.configuration.whitel: Block ids that are reported even though they hold a single slot. The block tag #holoinventorymodern:holo_view_whitelist does the same from a datapack.
